items.title: Multi-cursor: next occurrence
items.description: Select the word under the cursor, then add the next match.

items.title: Multi-cursor: all occurrences
items.description: Select every occurrence of the current selection.

items.title: Multi-cursor: add cursor with mouse or keys
items.body:
Alt+Click                      add a cursor
Ctrl+Alt+Up / Ctrl+Alt+Down    add cursor above / below
Shift+Alt+drag                 column (box) selection

items.title: Go to line / symbol
items.body:
Ctrl+G              go to line
Ctrl+Shift+O        go to symbol in file
Ctrl+T              go to symbol in workspace

items.title: Find and replace in file
items.body:
Ctrl+F    find
Ctrl+H    replace
Alt+R     toggle regex
Alt+C     toggle match case
Alt+W     toggle whole word
items.description: Open find and replace for the current file.

items.title: Find and replace across files
items.body:
Ctrl+Shift+F    search in files
Ctrl+Shift+H    replace in files

items.title: Regex replace with capture groups
items.description: Use groups in the Find box and $1, $2 in the Replace box (regex mode on).

items.title: Edit lines
items.body:
Alt+Up / Alt+Down           move line
Shift+Alt+Up / Down         duplicate line
Ctrl+Shift+K                delete line
Ctrl+/                      toggle line comment
Shift+Alt+A                 toggle block comment
items.description: Move, copy and delete lines without selecting.

items.title: Navigate code
items.body:
F12              go to definition
Alt+F12          peek definition
Shift+F12        find all references
F2               rename symbol
Ctrl+.           quick fix

items.title: Panels and layout
items.body:
Ctrl+`           toggle terminal
Ctrl+Shift+`     new terminal
Ctrl+B           toggle sidebar
Ctrl+\           split editor
Ctrl+K Z         zen mode

items.title: Open from the terminal
items.body:
code .             # open current folder
code -r file.txt    # reuse the open window
code --diff a.txt b.txt
items.description: Launch VS Code from a shell.

items.title: tmux: sessions
items.description: Create, list, attach, detach and kill sessions.

items.title: tmux: windows and panes
items.body:
c   new window         n / p   next / previous window
,   rename window      %   split left/right
"   split top/bottom    arrows   move between panes
z   zoom pane          x   close pane
items.description: Default prefix is Ctrl+b; press it, release, then the key.

items.title: tmux: scroll and copy mode
items.body:
Ctrl+b [     enter copy mode (q to quit)
# in copy mode: arrows/PageUp to scroll, / to search

items.title: tmux: minimal ~/.tmux.conf
items.body:
set -g mouse on
set -g history-limit 50000
set -g base-index 1

# reload:  tmux source-file ~/.tmux.conf
items.description: Enable mouse and a larger history, then reload.
